product_name: Bajaj Life Accidental Death Benefit Rider II
regulatory_descriptor: Bajaj Life Accidental Death Benefit (ADB) Rider II (an individual life-insurance rider attached to a base policy)
key_benefits: Additional accidental-death cover attached to a base policy; on accidental death the higher of the Rider Sum Assured or the Guaranteed Benefit (105% of Total Premiums Paid) is paid in addition to the base-policy death benefit.
Accidental death defined as death caused solely/directly by bodily injury from an accident, occurring within 180 days of the accident.
Optional Health Management Services (medical second opinion, case management, consultation) at no additional cost, subject to availability.

Rider Termination Value: payable immediately for Single Premium; not available for Regular Premium; for Limited Premium, available only after the premium-paying term. Termination Value = termination factor x Total Premiums Paid (factors not guaranteed).
No maturity benefit under the rider.
Option to add, surrender and re-add the rider subject to board-approved underwriting.

eligibility.policy_term: Aligned with the remaining term of the base policy
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Single, Regular or Limited (aligned with base policy)
eligibility.note: An 'Important Details' eligibility table is referenced but its numeric age/sum-assured/term values are not captured in the parse. Verify against the policy document.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the rider policy document (electronic or otherwise); not applicable to rider policies with tenure of less than a year. Refund subject to proportionate risk premium and medical/stamp-duty expenses.
key_terms.grace_period: As per the base policy; on non-payment the rider cover lapses on expiry of grace.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Suicide is an excluded cause of the accidental-death benefit (death as a result of suicide is not paid under this rider).
key_terms.guaranteed_benefit: Guaranteed Benefit = 105% of Total Premiums Paid under the rider (floor for the accidental-death payout).
key_terms.revival_note: Revival within the base-policy revival period; current revival interest 10.00% p.a. compounded half-yearly (benchmarked to 10-year G-Sec + 2%).
key_terms.tax_note: GST applicable per prevailing tax laws (subject to amendment); tax benefits subject to prevailing tax laws.

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a rider attached to a base policy — it cannot be marketed as a standalone plan; any claim must reference the base policy it augments.
The benefit pays ONLY on accidental death (death caused solely/directly by accidental bodily injury within 180 days) — must not be presented as covering death from any cause.
Payout is the higher of Rider Sum Assured or the Guaranteed Benefit (105% of premiums paid), in addition to the base-policy death benefit — state it accurately.
Rider Termination Value availability is premium-mode-specific (none for Regular Pay; only after PPT for Limited Pay) and factors are not guaranteed — must be stated with those conditions.
Health Management Services are optional, no-cost, third-party services subject to availability — not a guaranteed medical benefit or company liability.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as a savings/investment or maturity product — there is no maturity benefit; it is a pure protection rider.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' language — the only 'guaranteed' element is the 105%-of-premiums accidental-death floor.

Do NOT imply the rider pays on natural death or on death from any cause — a long list of exclusions (suicide, criminal acts, intoxication, hazardous sports, aviation, war, disease/infection, nuclear) applies.
Do NOT present the rider as a standalone policy.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: That it is the Bajaj Life Accidental Death Benefit Rider II, attached to a base policy, paying only on accidental death.
That there is no maturity benefit under the rider.
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full conditions and exclusions.
